title: Small Group 5-Hour DC Tour via Electric Scooter for Ages 16+
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Guests must be 16 years old or older.
policies: No flip flops or open toed sandals.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy this unique electric scooter tour of DC! Our scooters have huge tires as compared to other scooters, which provides a smooth, stable ride, for your one-of-a-kind fun. 

These amazing adult scooters provide a comfort level like no other: casual like a beach cruiser, but one might also feel like they’re floating on air because our big wheel scooters absorb everything. 

With all the wide sidewalks and bike paths, the National Mall in DC is perfect for your scooter experience. The oversized tires are perfect for gravel paths and smooth as butter on pavement. 

Classic handlebars provide a very natural upright standing position. The larger frame and wheels can support bigger riders with ease, but with a wide footplate, many guests can ride with both feet side by side.

These big wheel scooters are pretty much the perfect blend of low impact athletic awesomeness, cutting edge technology, and stunning design!
